original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹蒙德里流离失所家庭在持续不安全中艰难重建生活
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）报道，西赤道州蒙德里地区聚集了因凯迪巴暴力事件而流离失所的家庭，持续的不安全局势威胁着他们重建生活的努力。当地存在绑架、抢劫和性暴力等问题，枪声频发迫使居民放弃生计。UNMISS强调需加强平民保护，社区保护团体正协助流离失所者识别风险并获取信息。目前该报道为单一来源。

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Displaced by violence in Kediba, Western Equatoria, she sought refuge in Mundri, hoping to find safety.

key_facts.fact: 蒙德里地区持续存在绑架、抢劫和性暴力等安全问题
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: where abductions, looting and sexual violence compound the hardships of displacement

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) highlighted the importance of strengthening civilian protection and community-based responses to insecurity

key_facts.fact: 有民众在遭绑架后获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: There have been cases of abduction, with civilians later released.

key_facts.fact: 七年前从凯迪巴逃离的部分民众仍居住在流离失所营地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some people who fled from Kediba seven years ago are still living in this displacement camp
